features.name: User-facing README
features.description: English and Chinese README files explain product purpose, Claude Computer Use inspiration, prerequisites, API key setup, startup, shutdown, file handling, and safety notes.
features.evidence: README.md and README.zh-CN.md created and reviewed with targeted rg checks.

features.name: Product design spec
features.description: Design spec defines the DeepSeek-based computer use product, local web app shape, sandbox runtime, workspace file flow, safety model, and milestones.

features.name: Implementation plan
features.description: Implementation plan decomposes backend, frontend, runtime, model adapter, workspace, safety, and smoke verification tasks.

features.name: Lightweight development harness
features.description: Add AGENTS.md, feature_list.json, progress.md, and init.sh so future agent sessions have instructions, state, scope control, verification, and lifecycle checks.

features.name: Project scaffold
features.description: Create the backend, frontend, runtime, start/stop scripts, Docker Compose, and configuration skeleton described in the implementation plan.
features.evidence: Task 1 scaffold created. docker compose config passed. Backend pytest passed with 1 test. Frontend npm run build passed.

features.name: Computer action protocol
features.description: Implement provider-neutral action and observation models for screenshot, mouse, keyboard, scrolling, shell, and text-edit actions.
features.evidence: ComputerAction and Observation protocol models implemented. Protocol tests passed with 4 tests. Backend pytest passed with 5 tests.

features.name: Workspace and persistence foundation
features.description: Implement per-run workspace directories, path escape protection, SQLite schema, session helpers, and run repository basics.
features.evidence: Workspace manager and persistence modules implemented. Workspace tests passed with 2 tests. Backend pytest passed with 7 tests.

features.name: DeepSeek model adapter
features.description: Implement DeepSeek tool-call schema conversion, response parsing, and thinking-mode message handling.
features.evidence: DeepSeekAdapter originally implemented with a generic tool schema, then aligned to split computer/bash/text_editor schemas in feat-015. Adapter tests now pass as part of the 25-test backend suite.

features.name: Agent core and mock runtime
features.description: Implement runtime interface, mock runtime, safety policy, system prompt, and a basic agent loop that executes model tool calls through the runtime.
features.evidence: Runtime interface, mock runtime, safety policy, and AgentCore implemented. Safety and agent tests passed with 4 tests. Backend pytest passed with 13 tests.

features.name: Run and workspace API
features.description: Add FastAPI routes for run creation, workspace file upload/list/download, and run event WebSocket connection.
features.evidence: Run/workspace API and WebSocket implemented. API route tests passed with 3 tests. Backend pytest passed with 16 tests.

features.name: Sandbox runtime and web console
features.description: Implement Docker desktop runtime, noVNC viewing, local web console, workspace upload/download, and run controls.
features.evidence: DockerRuntime, runtime supervisor services, and local web console implemented. Runtime execution boundary was later aligned to a runtime action daemon in feat-015. Frontend npm run build passed. Backend pytest now passes with 25 tests.

features.name: Run execution controls
features.description: Wire run start, pause, resume, and cancel controls through FastAPI and the web UI, including a configuration guard for missing DeepSeek API keys.
features.evidence: Run control API and UI actions implemented. API route tests passed with 5 tests. Backend pytest passed with 18 tests. Frontend npm run build passed.

features.name: Smoke tests and user docs
features.description: Add API smoke tests and verify the user-facing README/startup path remains aligned with local web app usage.
features.evidence: API smoke tests passed with 2 tests. Backend pytest passed with 20 tests. Frontend npm run build passed. start.sh missing-key setup path passed.

features.name: Safety and evaluation
features.description: Add sensitive-action confirmation, action validation, audit trail, and smoke/evaluation workflows.
features.evidence: Lightweight audit/event trail implemented for run creation, file upload, start errors, pause, resume, and cancel. API route tests passed with 6 tests. Backend pytest passed with 21 tests. Frontend npm run build passed.

features.name: Claude demo alignment fixes
features.description: Align the design and implementation with the Anthropic quickstart and saved Zhihu field test: prebuilt runtime image path, split computer/bash/text_editor tools, normalized ToolResult, runtime action daemon boundary, and base64 screenshot results.
features.evidence: Design and implementation plan updated. Backend protocol, DeepSeek adapter, safety policy, runtime client, and runtime action daemon changes implemented. ./init.sh passed. docker compose config passed. docker compose dev overlay config passed. Backend pytest passed with 25 tests. Frontend npm run build passed. runtime/daemon.py py_compile passed.

features.name: Run budget visibility and runtime smoke workflow
features.description: Expose run step/token/cost budget metadata, enforce token budget in the agent loop, show usage in the web UI, and add a runtime smoke script for prebuilt or dev runtime images.
features.evidence: RunState now includes steps, token budget, token usage, and estimated cost. AgentCore enforces token budget when provider usage is available. Web run controls show step/token/cost metadata. scripts/smoke-runtime.sh added. Backend pytest passed with 25 tests. Frontend npm run build passed. Compose config and dev overlay config passed. bash -n smoke script and runtime daemon py_compile passed.

features.name: GHCR runtime image publishing
features.description: Configure the project to publish and consume a prebuilt runtime image from GitHub Container Registry under the pony-maggie GitHub account.
features.evidence: Runtime image name updated to ghcr.io/pony-maggie/computer-use-for-deepseek-runtime:latest and GitHub Actions workflow added. Workflow YAML parse passed. ./init.sh passed. docker compose config passed. Backend pytest passed with 25 tests. Frontend npm run build passed.

features.name: API cost optimization controls
features.description: Expose DeepSeek prompt cache hit/miss usage, keep a stable prompt/tool loop, de-duplicate repeated screenshots by hash, prefer browser DOM snapshots for browser tasks, enforce token and estimated cost budgets, and add configurable fast/pro model routing.
features.evidence: AgentCore cost budget enforcement, prompt cache token accounting, screenshot hash compaction, browser_snapshot tool action, RunState/UI budget fields, and routing config implemented. Backend pytest passed with 28 tests. Frontend npm run build passed. ./init.sh passed. Compose config, dev overlay config, runtime daemon py_compile, and feature_list JSON validation passed.

features.name: Voice input visibility fix
features.description: Make the browser voice input entry point obvious in the task panel and keep the harness aligned with the current voice input plan.
features.evidence: ChatPanel now renders a visible Voice label beside the microphone icon. Targeted ChatPanel test failed before the change and passed after it. Full frontend test suite and build passed.
